title: disktop report --output FILE --json
description: What `report` wrote. With --json the envelope is stdout's whole content, so the report itself always goes to --output; the document's own shape is report-document.json for JSON, and docs/cli.md describes the CSV and HTML forms. The file is created new and never replaces anything; an interrupted report writes nothing and exits 130.

output.description: The file the report was published as.

sections.description: The sections the report includes. Capacity is always one of them.
